purpose: A fixed comparison set for qualitative page and search-result review. It contains no traffic, adoption, ranking, backlink, or market-share estimates.

review_method: For each priority target, inspect one canonical competitor page and the bounded search sample; record content/task fit and visible installation or documentation pattern without inferring private strategy.
